name: list_tabs
summary: List the open tabs in Safari (title + URL), grouped by window, so you can answer 'what do I have open?' or find a page the user is looking at. Read-only. PRIVACY: open URLs can reveal what the user is browsing, so invoke it deliberately. Drives Safari via AppleScript, so the first use may prompt to grant Automation access to Safari.

params.name: window
params.description: 1-based index of a single Safari window to scope the listing to (window 1 is the frontmost). Omit to list tabs across every open window.

name: current_tab
summary: Show the title and URL of the tab the user is currently looking at — the active tab of Safari's front window. Read-only. PRIVACY: the URL can reveal what the user is browsing. Drives Safari via AppleScript; the first use may prompt to grant Automation access to Safari.
